presentations.summary: The Talos seized the volcano, and at its summit you slew Lord Vauthry, born part sin eater as an Ascian pawn. You could not hold the Wardens' combined Light, and the Exarch tried to carry it into the rift and die in your place, until Emet-Selch shot him and took him away. Only Ryne's power keeps you from becoming a sin eater.

citations.title: Extinguishing the Last Light — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: The Final Warden
presentations.summary: Light shrouds Norvrandt again because of the power you took from the Wardens, and only your friends know it; Ryne's power holds off your turning, for now. You woke in the Crystarium and walked its streets to calm the anxious citizens, who mean to search for their stolen steward.

citations.title: Extinguishing the Last Light — main scenario quest (5.0)
Reassuring the Masses — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: The Final Warden
presentations.summary: Emet-Selch holds the wounded Exarch, and Light again shrouds the sky. Seeking word of him, you learned he raised Lyna, lets no one else live in the tower, and that no one knows his true name. Ardbert has cast his lot with yours, and Lyna holds the key to the tower's heart.

citations.title: Extinguishing the Last Light — main scenario quest (5.0)
In His Garden — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: In the Crystal Tower's heart, an Echo showed the Exarch, whose true name is G'raha Tia, telling Urianger he came from a future Source ravaged by Calamity to save you, and meant to die doing it. Urianger kept his secret, but has now told the Scions. They and the Crystarium back your descent to Emet-Selch's lair in the Tempest.

citations.title: The Unbroken Thread — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: Emet-Selch holds G'raha Tia, whose body is the key to the Crystal Tower's power over time, so he is likely still in the Tempest. Urianger's way down was the Isle of Ken, an ancient fae being called Bismarck, which Feo Ul persuaded to carry you to the sea floor in a dome of air.

citations.title: To Storm-tossed Seas — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: On the Tempest's drained sea floor, the Scions search for Emet-Selch's stronghold. They found the Ondo, whose chieftain Tolshs Aath will welcome them only if they are the ancients' chosen, and who have seen an illuminated land shining in the abyss. Alphinaud means to make amends for their lost water.

citations.title: Waiting in the Depths — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: Searching the Tempest for Emet-Selch, you found ruins no knife can scratch, finer than anything the Ronkan Empire made. Y'shtola believes he chose them for the Ascian agenda, and that he lit the illuminated land the Ondo speak of. Winning the Ondo's trust is the swiftest way to find it.

citations.title: City of the Ancients — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: The Ondo would light their Walls to answer the illuminated land, where Emet-Selch likely hides, and need a sacred lamp to do it. Grenoldt, the craftsman who vanished from the Crystarium years ago, had not begun it for want of inspiration, so you showed him a crystal that belonged to one of Ardbert's companions.

citations.title: City of the Ancients — main scenario quest (5.0)
The Light of Inspiration — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Beneath the Tempest
presentations.summary: Grenoldt made the Ondo's lamp, and Tolshs Aath named you the sign his people awaited. An Ondo guide sent you down through the trench, and past the Caliban Gap you found a vast city that Emet-Selch has layered over ancient ruins. Somewhere inside, he holds G'raha Tia captive.

citations.title: The Illuminated Land — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Amaurot
presentations.summary: In the trench stands Amaurot, a memory Emet-Selch has raised from before the star was sundered, whose people, arcane entities to Y'shtola's eyes, believe their world is ending. They speak of the Convocation of Fourteen, whose seats include Lahabrea and Elidibus. The Scions spread out to learn where Emet-Selch hides.

citations.title: The End of a World — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Amaurot
presentations.summary: In Amaurot you learned that Emet-Selch himself approved your residency. A shade named Hythlodaeus told you that half his people died to create Zodiark, dissenters made Hydaelyn, and Emet-Selch will pay any price to restore the lost; you and Ardbert, he said, were once one soul. The Ascians mean to sacrifice the Source's lives.

citations.title: A Greater Purpose — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Amaurot
presentations.summary: In the Capitol, Emet-Selch challenged you to prove yourself worthy of his people's legacy, and nearly broke you as the Light burst its bonds. Ardbert and the living Exarch turned the fight, and Emet-Selch, revealed as Hades, fell to your axe of Light. With that world saved, the Scions are stuck there, and you returned home alone.

citations.title: Shadowbringers — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Halric
presentations.summary: A resident of the Inn at Journey's Head, cared for by its carers. The nectarine you bought there is his favorite fruit.

citations.title: A Purchase of Fruit — main scenario quest (5.0)

presentations.name: Halric
presentations.summary: A boy among patients whose souls stagnate under the Light. His soul is too far gone for a quick cure, his mind held together by the finest of threads.

citations.title: A Welcome Guest — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Halric
presentations.summary: A boy whose soul stagnates under the Light. A familiar that Alisaie sculpted with Beq Lugg's magick stirred him enough to speak a few words.

citations.title: Good for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Halric
presentations.summary: A boy recovering, slowly, from a stagnant soul. Alisaie has said goodbye, and Beq Lugg will oversee his treatment in her stead.

citations.title: An Old Friend — main scenario quest (5.2)
Nothing Unsaid — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou mage and master of soulcraft, who hid from the world of men in the Grand Cosmos and met you first as the Seeker of Solitude. Long ago, a court mage's good intentions and Beq Lugg's naivety cost countless innocent lives. Petitioned by the Crystal Exarch to save his comrades' souls, Beq Lugg struck a deal.

citations.title: A Grand Adventure — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft, now helping the Scions. Beq Lugg warns that their unstable souls could become impossible to transfer, and is treating patients whose souls stagnate under the Light with a soul tonic once used by the knights of Voeburt, hoping to learn from them.

citations.title: A Welcome Guest — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft whose knowledge once brought a plague. With water, clay and a fae lantern, Beq Lugg had Alisaie make a familiar that stirred Halric's soul, and believes a spell could induce stagnation to carry the Scions' souls safely home.

citations.title: Good for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft. With the Crystal Exarch and Urianger, Beq Lugg made a crystal spirit vessel to ferry the Scions' souls and minds between worlds, though it cannot yet receive memory.

citations.title: The Way Home — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft, left wounded when Elidibus stole the Crystal Exarch's spirit vessel. With the Exarch, Beq Lugg raised a ward over the Crystal Tower to hold Elidibus inside.

citations.title: The Converging Light — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft, who found the Crystal Exarch's soul and memories intact in his vessel and will try to return them to his body, though there is no knowing whether it will accept them. Beq Lugg will also oversee Halric's treatment once Alisaie leaves.

citations.title: Nothing Unsaid — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Beq Lugg
presentations.summary: A Nu Mou master of soulcraft, who had the Scions commit their memories and then their souls to spirit vessels, so that you could carry them across the rift, something no mage had dared before.

citations.title: Reflections in Crystal — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Wrenden
presentations.summary: Once chief advisor to Lord Vauthry's father, who left Eulmore when his values fell out of favor. Chai-Nuzz seeks his counsel, but Wrenden would first see him solve one of the city's problems on his own.

citations.title: For the People — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Wrenden
presentations.summary: A former advisor of Eulmore's rulers, who judges Chai-Nuzz more than qualified to be mayor now that he has captured three Talos alone. Chai has asked for his counsel in politics.

citations.title: For the People — main scenario quest (5.1)
Finding Good Help — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Venat
presentations.summary: An ancient who, by the record in Anamnesis Anyder, led the summoning of Hydaelyn and became Her heart to oppose Zodiark, vowing not to vanish from the world.

citations.title: Beneath the Surface — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The white-robed figure
presentations.summary: A figure in white robes at Zenos's side after he wrested back his flesh, who says he knows full well the prey Zenos will seek next.

citations.title: Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The white-robed figure
presentations.summary: A figure in white robes at Zenos's side. Hearing of Zenos's dream of the world ablaze, he wondered whether Emet-Selch had found a way, for precious few remember the Final Days.

citations.title: Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty — main scenario quest (5.1)
Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The white-robed figure
presentations.summary: The figure in white robes at Zenos's side, who wears Asahi's face and names himself Fandaniel.

citations.title: Reflections in Crystal — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Fandaniel
presentations.summary: An Ascian, the white-robed figure at Zenos's side. He wears Asahi's body as a mere vessel, with its vast fortune, and labors for his lord's ambitions now that the palace is theirs. He wonders gleefully whether Elidibus, the last of the unsundered, is gone.

citations.title: Reflections in Crystal — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: Fandaniel
presentations.summary: An Ascian wearing Asahi's body, who means to destroy the world in a recreation of the Final Days, and wants to die and take everyone with him. His towers have risen across the realm, his band is the Telophoroi, and his dragon is Lunar Bahamut. His patron is Lord Zenos; Elidibus disagreed with him, but thanks to you, he says, he is free of him.

citations.title: Futures Rewritten — main scenario quest (5.4)

presentations.name: Fandaniel
presentations.summary: An Ascian in Asahi's body who leads the Telophoroi. With Zenos's support he has rallied part of the splintered Garlean army to them, and his towers temper those who approach to Garlemald itself.

citations.title: Futures Rewritten — main scenario quest (5.4)
Unto the Breach — main scenario quest (5.5)

presentations.name: Fandaniel
presentations.summary: An Ascian in Asahi's body, leading the Telophoroi. Lunar Bahamut has fallen, and he admits Tiamat's return makes more Meracydian dragons hard to come by. In Garlemald's palace he calls the Empire an instrument of the star's destruction.

citations.title: Futures Rewritten — main scenario quest (5.4)
The Flames of War — main scenario quest (5.5)
When the Dust Settles — main scenario quest (5.5)

presentations.name: Fandaniel
presentations.summary: An Ascian in Asahi's body, leading the Telophoroi. His bid for a confluence at Carteneau failed, and he told you your victory earned only a stay of execution. He means to draw aether closer to home, through a gateway he calls complete.

citations.title: Futures Rewritten — main scenario quest (5.4)
Death Unto Dawn — main scenario quest (5.55)

presentations.name: Souls Adrift
presentations.summary: Krile has found that the link between the stricken Scions' bodies and their souls, stranded in the First, is weakening, worst in Thancred. You carried the news to the First, where the Scions settled on pouring their spirits into auracite so you could carry them home. The Crystal Exarch, whose summoning stranded them, may know someone who can help.

citations.title: Shaken Resolve — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Souls Adrift
presentations.summary: The Scions' souls are stranded in the First while their bodies weaken, and Urianger stayed behind to fashion white auracite to carry them. The Crystal Exarch led the rest of you to the Grand Cosmos, where you fought past its reclusive mage's familiars. The mage proved to be Beq Lugg, a Nu Mou master of soulcraft, who grudgingly struck a deal.

citations.title: Shaken Resolve — main scenario quest (5.1)
A Grand Adventure — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Souls Adrift
presentations.summary: Beq Lugg, a Nu Mou master of soulcraft, learned that the Scions come from another world and agreed to help, warning that their unstable souls could become impossible to transfer. Among patients whose souls stagnate under the Light, a soul tonic eased some, but the worst afflicted did not respond, and Halric's soul is too far gone.

citations.title: A Welcome Guest — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: Souls Adrift
presentations.summary: To stir the stagnant patients' souls, Beq Lugg had you gather pure water, clay and a fae lantern, and Alisaie sculpted a familiar that moved Halric to speak. Beq Lugg now believes a spell could induce stagnation to carry the Scions home, and Alisaie hopes the method could help Ga Bu. Then Kai-Shirr arrived with word that his city's future is at stake.

citations.title: Good for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: Kai-Shirr brought you and Alphinaud back to Eulmore, where Lady Chai is beside herself. No one stood for mayor after Lord Vauthry's fall, so the post fell to her husband, Chai-Nuzz, who soon vanished without a word. She fears she pushed him too hard, but Alphinaud is sure he has not fled and has promised to find him.

citations.title: Nowhere to Turn — main scenario quest (5.1)
Good for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: Eulmore's new mayor, Chai-Nuzz, has vanished, so you and Alphinaud questioned its people. Before he left, he fretted over the city's neglected industry and its thin defenses, with many soldiers still recovering from your clash with Lord Vauthry. He spoke of opening the Queen Bee to outsiders, and was last seen heading for Gatetown.

citations.title: A Notable Absence — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: Searching Kholusia's settlements for Eulmore's missing mayor, you found Chai-Nuzz trying to win back their goodwill. He will not take office until he has secured resources, and sought the counsel of Wrenden, once chief advisor to Lord Vauthry's father. Wrenden would first see him solve one problem alone, and Chai, heir to Daedalus Stoneworks, means to do it with Talos.

citations.title: For the People — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: To prove himself to Wrenden, Chai-Nuzz captured three of the abandoned Talos that roam Kholusia, disabling them with canisters while you kept watch. The Talos marched home, where Lady Chai was near speechless at the sight of her husband. Wrenden judged him more than qualified to be mayor, and Chai asked for his counsel.

citations.title: Finding Good Help — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: The Missing Mayor
presentations.summary: Chai-Nuzz has taken office as Eulmore's interim mayor, chosen to succeed Lord Vauthry. Before the people he vowed to undo Lord Vauthry's systems, proposed an open forum on the city's future, and named food, its neighbors and industry as the first tasks. Kai-Shirr wants to help build the new Eulmore, and Alphinaud judges it time for the Scions to go their own way.

citations.title: Moving Forward — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: An Emperor Slain
presentations.summary: The Scions found that white auracite would sever mind from soul, and are seeking another way. In the Source, Estinien's memories reached you through the Echo: Zenos has his own flesh back and murdered his father, Emperor Varis, before Estinien and Gaius. Imperial soldiers now fight over the throne, a white-robed figure counsels Zenos, and Elidibus walks in Ardbert's body.

citations.title: Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty — main scenario quest (5.1)

presentations.name: An Emperor Slain
presentations.summary: Emperor Varis is dead at Zenos's hand, and imperial soldiers fight over the throne. Maxima brought you and Krile to Raubahn, who sat in talks with Gaius. The Black Wolf warned that the VIIth Legion is secretly building a new Ultima Weapon, with a prototype bound for Eorzea. Raubahn is gathering a force in the Ghimlyt Dark and asks for your strength.

citations.title: Vows of Virtue, Deeds of Cruelty — main scenario quest (5.1)
Old Enemies, New Threats — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: An Emperor Slain
presentations.summary: With the Emperor slain and Zenos returned, Garlemald's course is impossible to predict. In the First, the Crystal Exarch, Beq Lugg and Urianger have made a spirit vessel to carry the Scions' souls and minds home, but it cannot receive memory without the blood of the Allagan emperors. The Exarch is seeking a way, and Lyna has asked to speak with you.

citations.title: The Way Home — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: Captain Lyna asked your help with a sin eater in Lakeland, but a stranger calling himself a Warrior of Light had already slain it. Afterwards she confided in Alphinaud that the Crystal Exarch has not been the same since he returned from the tempest, and seems younger. From him she knows the truth of Ardbert and his comrades.

citations.title: Seeking Counsel — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: Alphinaud urged the Scions to tell the Crystarium the truth of the Warriors of Light, whom its books call sin eaters or worse. As you spoke, Ardbert appeared in the crowd, claiming the star had brought him back, and urged the people to become Warriors of Light themselves. Since Emet-Selch's demise only Elidibus could be behind it, so the Scions watch from afar.

citations.title: Facing the Truth — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: An impostor wearing Ardbert's face, surely Elidibus, urges the people to become Warriors of Light. Y'shtola took you to the Qitana Ravel, where the Viis had found new chambers, and in the tomb of the archmage Tiuna, said to have had a gift like the Echo, a mural tied that gift to a starshower. Y'shtola sees in it what Emet-Selch showed you in Amaurot.

citations.title: Facing the Truth — main scenario quest (5.2)
A Sleep Disturbed — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: The Scions learned that the false Ardbert slays a nearby sin eater before visiting any town, to win its trust. With Thancred and Ryne, back from the Empty, you tracked him down, and he dropped the pretense: he is Elidibus, enacting the will of the Convocation. He scorned Alphinaud's appeal to Emet-Selch's last words, and Alphinaud believes he seeks the Rejoining.

citations.title: An Old Friend — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: The False Hero
presentations.summary: Elidibus, who wore Ardbert's face, seeks the Rejoining, and the Scions hope ancient ruins may explain him. Tolshs Aath, chieftain of the Ondo, told you that benthos raiding Ondo and Kholusian stores are raising an army against the finless, and covet ruins newly found deep within the illuminated land. Urianger would call on another's help to reach them.

citations.title: An Old Friend — main scenario quest (5.2)
Deep Designs — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients
presentations.summary: To reach the ruins deep within the illuminated land and bring Elidibus's schemes to light, Urianger led the Scions to Bismarck. The great creature will carry you down once his underbelly is cleared of barnacles, a task Urianger cannot do from the surface. Bismarck told you of Ken, a man who made a home on his back, and whom history has already forgotten.

citations.title: Deep Designs — main scenario quest (5.2)
A Whale's Tale — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients
presentations.summary: Bismarck carried the Scions down into Anamnesis Anyder, where you fought past the benthos and their leader. In its central chamber a device showed ancients summoning Hydaelyn, led by Venat, who became Her heart, while Elidibus became Zodiark's. Urianger wonders whether the Elidibus you know is a successor, and Y'shtola stayed behind to coax more from the device.

citations.title: Beneath the Surface — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients
presentations.summary: Y'shtola is studying Anamnesis Anyder while the false Ardbert's words stir the Crystarium. At the Exedra, Elidibus conjured a false starshower to wake the Echo in the people's sundered souls, as Hydaelyn does for Her minions, and hailed them as Warriors of Light. Thancred will shadow him, and the Exarch's memory experiments falter.

citations.title: Beneath the Surface — main scenario quest (5.2)
Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)

presentations.name: Records of the Ancients
presentations.summary: Elidibus's false starshower has stirred would-be Warriors of Light across the Crystarium, and Thancred shadows him. The librarian Moren taught you that many in Vrandtic history bore that title, until the Flood made it an insult, and Alphinaud suspects Hydaelyn is the common thread. Helping young Riqi-Tio toward becoming an apothecary, he saw that the wish to help was the people's own.

citations.title: Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)
In the Name of the Light — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Emissary Unmasked
presentations.summary: Elidibus has stirred the people to become Warriors of Light. At the Crystarium's lookout he accused you of murdering his brothers and vowed to strike you down. Alisaie admits her fractured soul is fading her memories, the Exarch's body is turning to crystal as he readies a plan, and Ryne has come running: Thancred has collapsed.

citations.title: Echoes of a Fallen Star — main scenario quest (5.2)
Heroic Dreams — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Emissary Unmasked
presentations.summary: Thancred collapsed, the link between his body and soul weakening since he rescued Urianger from drowning, and he reports black-clad strangers wherever Elidibus has gone. In the Source, the Scions' sleeping bodies have taken a turn for the worse, which Tataru and Krile kept quiet. Krile warns that their souls must return soon, and will bring an expert in Allagan lore.

citations.title: Fraying Threads — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Emissary Unmasked
presentations.summary: With the sleeping Scions failing, Krile brought Rammbroes, an expert in Allag, who had no answer: memory transference belonged to Allagan royalty alone. In the First, the Crystal Exarch means to fuse the spirit vessels with his own crystallized essence and test a sixth on himself. If it works, Urianger says, his soul should merge with his younger self's.

citations.title: Fraying Threads — main scenario quest (5.3)
Food for the Soul — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Emissary Unmasked
presentations.summary: While the others tended to black-masked Ascians, Thancred sent you to check on Y'shtola at Anamnesis Anyder, but Elidibus spirited her away and set you a trial of faces from your past. Y'shtola freed herself and exposed him as a primal, Zodiark's heart, strengthened by the desire for salvation. He confirmed it and vanished, vowing to gain the power to defeat you.

citations.title: Faded Memories — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Emissary Unmasked
presentations.summary: Y'shtola has exposed Elidibus as a primal, and he means to gain the power to defeat you. In the Capitol of phantom Amaurot you gathered crystals holding accounts of the Convocation, and Hythlodaeus gave you the crystal of its vacant Fourteenth seat, whose magick summons the stars to your side. Y'shtola suggests reaching out to Emet-Selch's brethren.

citations.title: Faded Memories — main scenario quest (5.3)
Etched in the Stars — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Exarch's Vigil
presentations.summary: Over Eulmore a second starshower brought an illusion of Amaurot and spectral warriors, heroes Elidibus summons from other worlds. Your airship came down in Amh Araeng, and near the Crystarium you found the Exarch and a wounded Beq Lugg. Elidibus has stolen the Exarch's spirit vessel, and with his royal blood the means to control the Crystal Tower, now sealed by their ward.

citations.title: The Converging Light — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Exarch's Vigil
presentations.summary: Holding the Crystal Tower with the Exarch's stolen vessel, Elidibus took the power of countless summoned heroes and rose as the Warrior of Light incarnate. With Hythlodaeus's crystal you called champions of your own and beat him. The Exarch stripped him of his power, you restored his memories before he faded, and the Exarch, turned wholly to crystal, entrusted his mind and memories to you.

citations.title: The Converging Light — main scenario quest (5.3)
Hope's Confluence — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Exarch's Vigil
presentations.summary: Elidibus has faded, and the Exarch's mind and memories travel with you in his spirit vessel, which Beq Lugg will try to return to his body. Y'shtola believes Emet-Selch foresaw his death and arranged Elidibus's release. Now the Scions say their farewells: Alisaie to Halric, Alphinaud to the Chais, and Ryne asks you to bring flowers for Minfilia.

citations.title: Hope's Confluence — main scenario quest (5.3)
Nothing Unsaid — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: The Exarch's Vigil
presentations.summary: With Elidibus gone, the Scions are saying farewell to Norvrandt. Urianger found a crystal after the battle, likely Ardbert's, which fell free when Elidibus consumed his body. You took it to Ardbert's old friend Seto, who saw Ardbert in your place and resolved to go on an adventure of his own.

citations.title: Nothing Unsaid — main scenario quest (5.3)
The Journey Continues — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: A Long Way Home
presentations.summary: With Elidibus defeated and the Exarch's soul in your keeping, the Scions said their goodbyes. Y'shtola promised Runar she would find a way to travel between worlds, and Thancred, ready to leave, lets Ryne walk her own path. In the Crystarium, Lyna bade you tell the Exarch, when he wakes, that he need no longer hide who he truly is.

citations.title: Hope's Confluence — main scenario quest (5.3)
Unto the Morrow — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: A Long Way Home
presentations.summary: Beq Lugg moved the Scions' memories and souls into spirit vessels, and in the Source your friends woke in their own bodies. You carried the Exarch's vessel to the Crystal Tower, and days later a bright-eyed youth named G'raha Tia joined the Scions. In the imperial palace, Zenos sits on the throne beside the Ascian Fandaniel, who wears Asahi's body.

citations.title: Reflections in Crystal — main scenario quest (5.3)

presentations.name: A Long Way Home
presentations.summary: With the Scions back in their bodies, Lyse brought word of civil war in the Empire since the Emperor's assassination, and invited them to an Alliance council in Ala Mhigo. Thancred means to go to Garlemald. You and G'raha Tia instead joined Alisaie's search for a cure for tempering, for Ga Bu's sake, and flew to Azys Lla on Tataru's new airship.

citations.title: Alisaie's Quest — main scenario quest (5.4)

presentations.name: A Long Way Home
presentations.summary: While the other Scions head for the Alliance council, you, Alisaie and G'raha Tia seek a cure for tempering on Azys Lla. The report you sought had been deleted, but its author's archive node lay in the sealed Habisphere. Once G'raha restarted the locks, the node recognized him as royalty but refused his passwords, so you are taking it to Cid.

citations.title: Alisaie's Quest — main scenario quest (5.4)
